title: GenLayerTransactionLifecycle
description: Protocol transaction lifecycle state only (CLAUDE.md Section 9.1). Rebuilt per external A0 review finding A0-005: `rawStatus` and `rawResult` are taken verbatim from the pinned `genlayer-js@2.0.0-rc.1` package's own `TransactionStatus` and `TransactionResult` enums (independently extracted from `node_modules/genlayer-js/dist/index-BT1ApAqQ.d.ts` in the pinned tarball on 2026-09-10 - not invented, not guessed from stale examples). This schema never merges finalization (`rawStatus`) with the retained consensus result (`rawResult`), and never merges either with Reclose's own DecisionOutcome, which is a completely separate application-level concept living only in DecisionRecord.schema.json. A `derived` display object is permitted for UI convenience but is explicitly marked derived and must never replace the raw fields above it (e.g. the CLI's own composed label 'Finalized · Accepted', observed live at G0 in release-evidence/r1/g0/deploy-success-pinned/smoke-deployment-receipt.txt, is a derived display string, not a raw SDK status value).

rawStatus.description: Verbatim genlayer-js@2.0.0-rc.1 TransactionStatus. `FINALIZED` is a lifecycle terminal state ONLY - it says nothing about whether the retained result was accepted, undetermined, or execution succeeded (TM-LIFE-001/002). `UNDETERMINED` here is the protocol's own lifecycle/decision-outcome concept and is NOT the same value space as Reclose's DecisionOutcome.UNDETERMINED (TM-LIFE-003) - a test must exist proving these are distinct (see tests/frontend-fixtures).

rawResult.description: Verbatim genlayer-js@2.0.0-rc.1 TransactionResult (the retained consensus round result). Null when `rawStatus` has not yet reached a state that carries a round result (e.g. PENDING). Never invented values such as 'SPLIT' - these 9 are the actual enum members in the pinned package.

protocolDecisionOutcome.description: genlayer-js's own consumer-oriented `TransactionDecisionOutcome` (lowercase, hyphenated - taken verbatim from the pinned package's type definitions). This is a THIRD distinct concept from `rawStatus`/`rawResult` above and from Reclose's DecisionOutcome (CONFIRMED/REJECTED/UNDETERMINED) in DecisionRecord.schema.json. Never conflate the three.

derived.description: Optional UI-convenience display derived from the raw fields above. Must never be treated as protocol truth and must never be the only field a consumer reads.

displayLabel.description: Human display string such as 'Finalized · Accepted', explicitly derived from rawStatus + rawResult, never a raw protocol enum value on its own.

isFinal.description: Derived boolean convenience: true only when rawStatus is FINALIZED or CANCELED. Never treat this alone as execution success (TM-LIFE-002) - always check ExecutionResult and, where required, target post-state.

allOf.description: Schema-level enforcement (A0-R6) that derived.isFinal cannot contradict rawStatus: terminal states are exactly FINALIZED and CANCELED.
Schema-level enforcement (A0-R6) that a non-terminal rawStatus can never claim derived.isFinal === true.
